newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: NSA TO HOLD 280 MLN RAND RIGHTS ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: NSA TO HOLD 280 MLN RAND RIGHTS ISSUE.

text.p: Investment group NSA Investments announced on Thursday it would raise 280 million rand in a rights issue to fund the group's expansion.
In terms of the offer, option and shareholders would be offered a linked unit comprising one new share and one fifth of a share option at a cost of 14.00 rand.
Thirty linked units were being offered for each 100 shares or 100 options held on October 4 1996.
Chairman Arnie Witkin said institutional shareholders who held more than 80 pecent of NSA's shares and options had already indicated that they would follow their rights.
The cash raised would be used to finance acquisitions of stakes in high growth businesses and to fund growth in some of its existing investments, Witkin said.
"NSA's strategy is to take significant minority shareholdings in high growth listed and unlisted businesses and to work with the managements of those businesses to help them grow," he said.
Although NSA currently had about 75 million rand in cash, all of this had been earmarked for indentified investments, he added.
The group, which has a market capitalisation of over one billion rand, recently announced a 70 percent increase in diluted earnings per share to 63 cents in the year to June 30 1996.
It already has stakes in Housewares , Educor, Control Instruments and Real Africa .
